title: Bengaluru (Yesvantpur)–Madgaon Vande Bharat via Mangaluru (26655/26656): about 13 hours; PM flag-off 13 Nov 2026, regular runs from 15 Nov; 07:35→20:55, return 08:20→21:15; Mangaluru Jn 15:05 / 13:50; 12 stops; six days a week; replaces the Mangaluru–Madgaon Vande Bharat (about an hour longer on that stretch); Karnataka Railway Vedike says the Goa extension makes the trip too long

PM Modi flags it off in Bengaluru on Fri: https://metrorailnews.in/yesvantpur-mangaluru-madgaon-vande-bharat-flag-off-timings-stops/ (13 Nov, ~2 pm Bengaluru; Vaishnaw at Mangaluru Jn ~2:30 pm)
https://daijiworld.com/news/newsDisplay?newsID=1334945 (Friday 13 Nov, 2 pm, Bengaluru; Vaishnaw and MPs at Mangaluru Junction)
Six days a week: no run from Yesvantpur: https://metrorailnews.in/yesvantpur-mangaluru-madgaon-vande-bharat-flag-off-timings-stops/ (no service Wednesdays from Yesvantpur, Thursdays from Madgaon)
Karnataka Railway Vedike says it suits B: https://coastaldigest.com/mangaluru-vande-bharat-route-faces-heat-over-13-hour-bengaluru-goa-journey (K N Krishna Prasad, Karnataka Railway Vedike: 'taking it to Goa makes the journey too long'; bypassing Mangaluru Central)
https://mypunepulse.com/new-vande-bharat-express-bengaluru-to-goa-route-faces-criticism-over-13-hour-journey (same quote; commuters object to bypassing Mangaluru Central)
On the Mangaluru–Madgaon stretch it take: https://coastaldigest.com/mangaluru-vande-bharat-route-faces-heat-over-13-hour-bengaluru-goa-journey (Mangaluru–Madgaon stretch an hour longer than the existing Vande Bharat)
https://mypunepulse.com/new-vande-bharat-express-bengaluru-to-goa-route-faces-criticism-over-13-hour-journey (Mangaluru–Madgaon takes an hour longer than the existing Vande Bharat)
